title: CTO Outstanding Technical Achievement Award, one of about 30 worldwide
summary: At the 2021 CTO Annual Address I was one of about 30 people across Philips' global technology organization named for an Outstanding Technical Achievement Award, cited for teaching coding to non-technical compliance officers and for a data-driven hiring framework.
what_would_have_happened: Not applicable: a recognition event, not an intervention.
what_i_did: The citation named two things: teaching coding to non-technical compliance officers, and a data-driven hiring framework.
what_changed: Company-wide recognition in front of the whole technology organization.

quotes.text: Exceptional results, demonstrating role model behaviour
